title: CXMT上市热度高：晨星称反应过度，存储商品属性下估值贵不贵？
speaker: Lorraine Tan

segments.en: The, so I get the Chinese tech earnings are on the softer side.
segments.zh: 中国科技企业盈利表现偏软。

segments.en: The markets have been so unforgiving when you look at how they're just quick to sell the Chinese equity story.
segments.zh: 市场反应严厉，迅速抛售中国权益资产。

segments.en: What do you make of these dynamics and just take us to how you're looking at this?
segments.zh: 你如何看待这些动态？请谈谈你的看法。

segments.en: Yeah, so I think there is a huge, obviously, a lot of excitement with, you know, listing of CXMT, you know, and I think that obviously there was a little bit overdone to the reaction
segments.zh: CXMT上市引发巨大兴奋，但市场反应有些过度。

segments.en: there. We do think that stock is particularly still expensive.
segments.zh: 我们认为该股仍然偏贵。

segments.en: And, you know, we see so that even with Escahionics and Samsung on a memory side that huge run up.
segments.zh: 我们看到，即便在存储领域，海力士和三星也大幅上涨。

segments.en: So the whole tech sector globally, you know, essentially was the only outperforming sector for most of this year.
segments.zh: 全球科技板块今年大部分时间是唯一跑赢的板块。

segments.en: And so, you know, even with the correction that we're seeing now, you know, that's come it's still up for the year.
segments.zh: 即便现在出现调整，年内仍保持上涨。

segments.en: Now on the China side, you don't actually have a lot of the big chip companies or infrastructure companies in terms of AI that benefit.
segments.zh: 在中国，受益于AI的大型芯片和基础设施公司并不多。

segments.en: And so even with CXMT, which is a beneficiary, the fact is that on a memory side, these are commodities.
segments.zh: 即便CXMT是受益者，但存储产品本质上是商品。

segments.en: And with the capacity that's coming out, we're beginning to see the peak of those, those price rises, chip price rises.
segments.zh: 随着产能释放，我们开始看到芯片价格涨势见顶。

segments.en: In fact, we are beginning to see, we do expect some of the prices to start coming off.
segments.zh: 事实上，我们开始看到，确实预计部分价格将开始回落。

segments.en: And so you do have that pressure now in terms of the cycle for the semiconductor names.
segments.zh: 因此，半导体板块目前确实面临周期压力。

segments.en: How is Anthropic going to do, you know, what impact could it have?
segments.zh: Anthropic将如何表现，可能带来什么影响？
